objectives: “This course is designed to develop an understanding of the financial institutions and the risk management.  Topics covered included introduction of different financial institutions, risk of financial institutions, and how to measure and manage the risk.
content:
Why are financial institutions special?
Depository institutions
Insurance
Securities brokerage ＆ Investment banking
Mutual fund ＆ Hedge funds
Risks of financial institution
books:
“Textbook: Financial Institutions Management, A Risk Management Approach (11th ed.) by Saunders, Cornett, and Erhemjamts McGraw Hill, 2023, distributed by Hwa Tai Publishing

Course Note: Available on Blackboard during the term

References:
Financial Markets and Institutions (8th ed.) by Mishkin and Eakins, Pearson, 2014, distributed by Hwa Tai Publishing
金融機構與市場  陳錦村, 2013 新陸書局“
grading_policy:
5 minute challenge 15％
Speaking and writing test 5％
Class participation 22.5％
Group Project 57.5％
